manifest.name: US severe weather alerts
manifest.description: Pushes official National Weather Service alerts for your US location or state, using the free weather.gov API.
manifest.author: Ferry

settings.label: Location (lat,lon or state code)
settings.help: Right-click your spot in Google Maps or OpenStreetMap and copy the coordinates, like 32.7767,-96.7970. Or enter a two-letter state code like TX for the whole state.

settings.label: Lowest severity to push
settings.help: One of Minor, Moderate, Severe or Extreme.
